Android footer-baseline-v2 measures a stable 116px form-footer displacement when NativeWind positioning alone leaves the 48dp control in flow. Classes retain size, shape and semantic colors; footer placement stays in flow.

Gorhom Bottom Sheet background, container, handle, and detached sheet APIs require native style objects. The current-detent outer clip follows measured library geometry on the UI thread, preserving the inner keyboard scroll viewport.

T01 (16 Nov 2026): react-native-css 3.0.1 drops an element's className styles when it also receives an inline style, and Reanimated views take no className. Runtime values (shadows, safe-area insets, animated transforms, measured sizes) therefore live on style-only wrappers; static styling stays in className on sibling/child elements.
